message.aizen_stand.awakened: The arrow pierces you... your stand awakens: Sovereign Heaven.
message.aizen_stand.awakened_hint: Press G to summon the stand
message.aizen_stand.no_stand: You have no stand. Right-click a Stand Arrow first.
